descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Sydney puts you in the captain's seat over the real Sydney.

THE REAL SYDNEY
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Opera House, the Harbour Bridge, Sydney Tower, Circular Quay, Darling Harbour, the Anzac and Gladesville bridges, Bondi, Manly, the Heads, Botany Bay and the Blue Mountains on the horizon. Two airports: Kingsford Smith and RAAF Richmond.

A LIVING CITY
Manly ferries, yachts, cruise ships, the navy at Garden Island, double-deck trains over the Harbour Bridge, the light rail, thousands of cars, airliners in the sky. Jacarandas in bloom; at night the harbour lights up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the harbour, the Opera House and the Bridge out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the harbour city approach, RAAF Richmond, the coastline run, UNDER THE BRIDGE, Botany Bay, a fighter scramble, harbour lights at night and a Sydney tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
